result:
The decisive mistake was made by ResultVerification_Expert at step 6. After frame extraction, it proposed an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNetB0 classifier. That model outputs one label per whole frame. It cannot count distinct bird species appearing together, and it can't identify species reliably. The script also counts a species only if the label contains the word "bird", which would miss most species names. This approach could never produce the correct answer of 3, so everything after it was wasted.
